best_match.fbbt_definition: See FBrf0211729 for image. Adult uniglomerular antennal lobe projection neuron from the ad (ALad1) neuroblast lineage whose dendrites mainly innervate antennal lobe glomerulus D. This is the fourth cell type to be generated post-embryonically by neuroblast ALad1 (Yu et al., 2010). There are around three of these per hemisphere, they fasciculate with the medial antennal lobe tract and they are cholinergic (Bates et al., 2020).

justification: D PNs; the authors' lineage adPN. Mature term from the pharate adult stage (curator).
